summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses whether the custom of saying the berakha "Barukh shepetarani me'onsho shel zeh" at a Bar Mitzvah is part of our tradition. He examines the source in the Shulhan Arukh and the gloss of Muram, and shares the testimony of Rabbi Shemtob Gaguine in Keter Shem Tob.
questions: What is the berakha of Barukh shepetarani me'onsho shel zeh?
Is saying Barukh shepetarani our minhag?
Where is the custom of Barukh shepetarani mentioned in the Shulhan Arukh?
What does Rabbi Shemtob Gaguine write about Barukh shepetarani in Keter Shem Tob?
